    "# This cell is removed with the tag: \"remove-input\"\n",

    "import warnings\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n"

  {

   "id": "4c13badd",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "(Tutorial_Get_rmsf)=\n",
    "# Get RMSF\n",
    "\n",
    "*Calculating root-mean-square fluctuations per atom over a trajectory.*\n",
    "\n",
    "The function {func}`molsysmt.structure.get_rmsf` computes the root-mean-square fluctuation (RMSF) of each atom around its time-averaged spatial position across a trajectory or structural ensemble.\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{versionadded} 1.0.0\n",
    ":::\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{admonition} API documentation\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "Follow this link for a detailed description of the input arguments, raised errors, and returned objects of this function: {func}`molsysmt.structure.get_rmsf`.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "619a428d",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Basic usage\n",
    "\n",
    "Let's show how to calculate atomic fluctuations over a pentalanine simulation (first superposing all frames onto the reference frame to isolate pure internal flexibility from rigid-body tumbling):\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "1f382db3",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:37:14.945010Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:37:14.944601Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:37:16.190200Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:37:16.189114Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import molsysmt as msm\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import pyunitwizard as puw\n",
    "import numpy as np\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "f16d6f96",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:37:16.193104Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:37:16.192703Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.224671Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.223265Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "molsys = msm.convert(msm.systems['pentalanine']['traj_pentalanine.h5msm'])\n",
    "molsys_fitted = msm.structure.least_rmsd_fit(molsys, selection='all', selection_fit='backbone', reference_structure_index=0)\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "42f5b135",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    ":::{note} Demo Systems Catalog\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "This tutorial uses demonstration datasets provided by MolSysMT. To explore the full catalog of bundled systems, forms, and file paths, visit the {ref}`Demo Systems <user-foundations-entrance-demo-systems>` guide.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "131cd20f",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We calculate the RMSF across all atoms using {func}`molsysmt.structure.get_rmsf`:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "2a40f45d",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.228284Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.227753Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.702766Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.701543Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "rmsf_all = msm.structure.get_rmsf(molsys_fitted, selection='all')\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "e7935acb",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.705302Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.705028Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.710441Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.709245Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "RMSF array shape: (62,)\n",
      "Average RMSF over all atoms: 0.2551 nanometer\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "print('RMSF array shape:', rmsf_all.shape)\n",
    "print(f'Average RMSF over all atoms: {rmsf_all.mean():.4f}')\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "bf37132b",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plotting per-atom fluctuation profile\n",
    "\n",
    "We plot the RMSF profile along all atom indices to identify regions of elevated atomic flexibility:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "0a2ff26b",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.714184Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:37:25.713902Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:37:26.066148Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:37:26.064569Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 900x450 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "rmsf_val = puw.get_value(rmsf_all, to_unit='nm')\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(9, 4.5))\n",
    "plt.plot(range(len(rmsf_val)), rmsf_val, marker='o', color='teal', lw=1.5, markersize=4, label='All Atoms RMSF')\n",
    "plt.xlabel('Atom Index')\n",
    "plt.ylabel('RMSF (nm)')\n",
    "plt.title('Root-Mean-Square Fluctuations Profile')\n",
    "plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)\n",
    "plt.legend()\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "4aaf88df",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Per-residue fluctuation analysis\n",
    "\n",
    "We can compute the average fluctuation for each residue group to assess backbone and sidechain mobility by residue:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "77f14b7d",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:37:26.070066Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:37:26.069648Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:37:26.342642Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:37:26.341303Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 800x400 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "groups = msm.get(molsys, element='group', atom_index=True)\n",
    "group_names = msm.get(molsys, element='group', name=True)\n",
    "res_rmsf = [np.mean(rmsf_val[atom_idx]) for atom_idx in groups]\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))\n",
    "plt.bar(range(len(res_rmsf)), res_rmsf, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.85, width=0.6)\n",
    "plt.xticks(range(len(res_rmsf)), [f'{name}_{i}' for i, name in enumerate(group_names)])\n",
    "plt.xlabel('Residue')\n",
    "plt.ylabel('Mean RMSF (nm)')\n",
    "plt.title('Mean Fluctuation per Residue')\n",
    "plt.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "1c5f4b71",
   "metadata": {},
